newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: James Hardie sells amusement park stake.
newsitem.headline: James Hardie sells amusement park stake.

text.p: Building materials group James Hardie Industries Ltd said on Thursday it has sold its 23.75 percent stake in Australia's Wonderland amusement park located in Sydney for A$11.9 million.
"James Hardie's share of the sale proceeds crystallises an after tax loss of about A$1.5 million," it said.

It said it acquired its interest in 1984 when it formed a joint venture with three other partners to build and operate the park. The sales agreement provides for each partner to sell its interest in Australia's Wonderland to Hartford Lane Pty Ltd.
